a.lede: Agentic AI led to a sixfold year-on-year influx of new code at GitHub, leading the company to add 4 million CPU cores and 160PB of storage to its datacenters
a.title: GitHub says massive influx of AI-generated code required extra 4 million CPU cores and 160 petabytes of storage to manage

b.lede: Intel is expanding chipmaking and advanced packaging capacity across the U.S., Ireland, and Malaysia to meet surging AI-driven demand for data center CPUs amid shrinking PC market and persistent supply constraints.
b.title: Intel shifts production capacity from consumer to server CPUs in face of 'unprecedented' AI demand
